title: Clock host machine
statement: Given a deterministic Boolean Turing machine $S$, a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine $A$, and a Boolean parameter $	extit{loop}$, define a nondeterministic Turing machine with $S.k + A.k + 1$ work tapes and states given by the clock phases associated with the state sets of $S$ and $A$. Its initial state is the boot phase containing the initial state of $S$, and its transition function is the clocked transition rule determined by $S$, $A$, and $	extit{loop}$.
caveat: The provided snippet does not define the clocked transition rule, so its behavior cannot be stated more explicitly from the given ground truth.
